name: No-Push-Up Burpee
summary: A full-body conditioning exercise combining a squat, a kick back into a plank, and an explosive vertical jump without performing a push-up.

setup: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
steps: Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower into a squat, placing both hands flat on the floor directly beneath your shoulders.
Jump both feet straight back into a high plank position, maintaining a rigid straight line from head to heels.
Quickly jump your feet forward, landing flat-footed just behind your hands in a low squat position.
Explode vertically off the floor into a jump, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, immediately absorbing the impact by sinking into the next repetition.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you squat down and jump your feet back, then exhale sharply as you jump your feet in and explode off the floor.
cues: Hands down, kick back, snap forward, jump high
Brace your core in the plank to prevent hip sag

common_faults.fault: Sagging the hips and hyperextending the lower back when kicking out into the plank.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze the glutes and brace the abdominals to lock into a rigid plank position before jumping forward.

common_faults.fault: Landing on the toes with knees caving in when jumping back to the squat.
common_faults.correction: Jump the feet wide enough to plant the whole foot flat on the floor with knees tracking over toes.

common_faults.fault: Landing with stiff, locked knees on the vertical jump.
common_faults.correction: Absorb the landing softly through the ankles, knees, and hips, transitioning smoothly into the descent.

precautions: Ensure adequate floor space and good shoe traction to prevent slipping when kicking legs back.
